hierarchy.evidence: The drawing and prominent product name identify the bowl immediately, and pairing $46 with “Add to bag” makes the purchase action easy to find at both widths.

spacing.evidence: The desktop columns and mobile gutters align cleanly, though the large gap below the mobile shipping line leaves the price far from the product details.

typography.evidence: The serif title shifts from two lines on desktop to one legible line on mobile, and the bold “5 days” makes the shipping estimate easy to scan.

color.evidence: The cream page and ochre drawing give the bowl a warm setting, while the plum button with white lettering singles out the purchase action at both widths.

accessibility.evidence: At both widths the readable purchase row is backed by a browser tree that names the drawing, exposes “Add to bag” and “Bag, 0 items,” and includes a status region.

fidelity.evidence: Kiln & Field’s bowl drawing, $46 price, five-day shipping and Milwaukee maker credit match the brief, with confirmation after adding one bowl still unverified.
